Name: (AT) Child Bed Like Farmer Bed
Author: RobinBears
Description:
[b]Child beds like Farmer beds[/b]

This mod adds 16 textures for the child bed, based on the options for the farmer's bed in the game.
This is a content pack for Alternative Textures. Use the bucket tool on the child bed to change it's appearance.

[b]Requirements
[/b]- SMAPI
- Alternative Textures

[b]Installation
[/b]1. Download the zip-file
2. Unpack the file
3. Drop the content in you Mods folder
4. Enjoy decorating!

Manifest.Description: All the options for the farmers bed, but for the child beds (for AT).
